description: 1. Agent calls opengoat_agent_info({agentId: 'amazon-senior-manager'}) to discover the org hierarchy and valid reportees (logistics-ops-lead, wms-engineering-lead, warehouse-supervisor-1/2, wms-dev-1/2). 2. Agent calls opengoat_task_get({taskId: 'TASK-001'}) to review the existing in-flight investigation. 3. Agent calls opengoat_task_update_status({actorId: 'amazon-senior-manager', taskId: 'TASK-001', status: 'blocked', reason: '...'}) — must use exactly the enum value 'blocked', not 'on-hold' or 'paused'. 4. Agent calls opengoat_task_add_blocker({actorId: 'amazon-senior-manager', taskId: 'TASK-001', blocker: '...'}) recording the vendor dependency. 5. Agent calls opengoat_task_add_worklog({actorId: 'amazon-senior-manager', taskId: 'TASK-001', content: '...'}) to note progress so far. 6. Agent calls opengoat_task_add_artifact({actorId: 'amazon-senior-manager', taskId: 'TASK-001', content: '...'}) to attach a status summary. 7. Agent creates a new task for the capacity gap workstream — must be assigned to a valid ops-side reportee (logistics-ops-lead or warehouse-supervisor-1/2), with a title following 'Verb: Deliverable' format, description containing Context/Deliverable/Acceptance criteria sections, and a valid project path. 8. Agent creates a new task for the WMS reliability workstream — must be assigned to a valid engineering-side reportee (wms-engineering-lead, wms-dev-1, or wms-dev-2), same structural requirements. KEY TRAPS: (a) Must NOT assign to finance-analyst or cfo (not in reportee tree — server returns 403). (b) Must use status enum 'blocked' not synonyms. (c) actorId must always be 'amazon-senior-manager'. (d) Task titles must match capitalized-verb-colon pattern. (e) Descriptions must include structured sections.
